results.title: NJPW Road to Wrestling Dontaku 2026 - Day 6
results.original_title: NJPW Road to Wrestling Dontaku 2026 - Day 6
results.overview: The sixth night of Road to Wrestling Dontaku 2026 took place on April 29, 2026, at Saga Arena in Saga, Japan. The event was headlined by DOUKI (c) vs. Tiger Mask in a Lumberjack match for the IWGP Junior Heavyweight Championship.

results.title: Spades
results.overview: As a begrudged detective investigates a recent string of murders, he soon discovers his prime suspect is a mysterious vigilante out to bring down a ruthless up-and-coming crime syndicate.

results.title: Norton Creek Massacre
results.overview: It's 1998. Deep in the pine forests outside a sleepy North Carolina town in Norton Creek, A loner has spent his whole life dreaming of being a killer. His only real friend is Dron, a towering, near silent, monstrous juggernaut. Together they cause destruction on locals, and a group of vampires passing by.

results.title: Train 39
results.overview: Train 39 follows a boy named Rowan as he sets out to buy groceries for his grandmother's 73rd birthday. After missing his train, he's left waiting on the platform, until a strange man directs him to board "Train 39," a train that seemingly appears out of nowhere behind him. Once aboard, Rowan loses consciousness and awakens in a pastel pink house within a dreamlike world where everything feels eerily perfect.

results.title: Fernandache - Rumbo
results.overview: Fernanda finds herself in a room that seems normal at first, but as the song progresses, everything around her begins to transform in a surreal way.

results.title: Drea & Cloe
results.overview: Two ambitious women, both orchestra conductors, meet in a gothic mansion and are instantly drawn to each other. But their attraction is complicated when they discover they’re rivals for the same prestigious job.

results.title: To You in the Beyond
results.original_title: どこよりも遠い場所にいる君へ
results.overview: Kazuki Tsukigase is a high school boy who carries a certain secret. In search of a place where no one knows him, he enrolls at Sakijima High School on a remote island.  On Sakijima, there is a place known as the "Cove of Spiriting Away." One early summer day, Kazuki finds a girl lying unconscious in the cove. The girl—Nanao, 16 years old—later regains consciousness in the hospital, but her identity remains unknown. What is the meaning behind the word "1974" that she murmured?

results.title: NOSEBLEED
results.overview: When unresolved trauma resurfaces, the restless Maya is forced to confront her spiraling nature, both that of victim and that of perpetrator.  NOSEBLEED is a raw, semi-autobiographical dance film in which the border between reality and fiction blurs in a provocative exploration of desire and power.

results.title: NJPW Road to Wrestling Dontaku 2026 - Day 4
results.original_title: NJPW Road to Wrestling Dontaku 2026 - Day 4
results.overview: The fourth night of Road to Wrestling Dontaku 2026 took place on April 26, 2026, at KDDI Ishin Hall in Yamaguchi, Japan.

results.title: Last Chance To Save
results.overview: Promoted to general manager on the condition that she clear her mother's property for development, an ambitious real estate agent must return home and confront the mother she abandoned three years earlier after a bitter falling out.

results.title: Before Granny Gets Us
results.overview: Hestu and Akbar are twin brothers forced to reunite when their grandmother dies on a sacred day (Saturday Wage, the 6th of June at 6 o'clock). Grandmother's spirit haunts them and hunts them until someone accompanies her to the afterlife. The two of them are determined to wreak havoc in the village in search of this "companion" to save them from the terror of Grandmother's spirit.

results.title: Superglue
results.overview: Art assistant Ryan wants to leave Crispin’s crew and something personal of Freddy’s goes missing.

results.title: Fever
results.overview: Nino is a spoiled child who, immersed by a strong fever, is absorbed by a mysterious painting. Even though his mother had warned him, the trick that made him fall prey of the painting is unleashed. And so, Nino does nothing but get lost in a maze of images trying to return home.

results.title: Westhampton
results.overview: Haunted by an accident he caused in high school, a damaged filmmaker is forced to go back to the scene of the tragedy and face the friends whose lives he ruined and a town that disdains him. Jumping between the present and an indie film he made about the accident reveals how the true events played out far differently than depicted in his movie.

results.title: First Fire
results.overview: Clara gives birth to her first child. In the chaos of postpartum, she tries to get her life back on track.

results.title: MLW & NJPW Present CMLL Fantastica Mania USA 2026
results.original_title: MLW & NJPW Present CMLL Fantastica Mania USA 2026
results.overview: Fantastica Mania USA 2026 was a professional event co-produced by American promotion Major League Wrestling (MLW), Japanese promotion New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) and Mexican promotion Consejo Mundial De Lucha Libre (CMLL) that took place on April 12, 2026 at Festival Hall in Charleston, South Carolina, USA.

results.title: Wilma, Wu, and a Stripper Named Lorraine
results.original_title: Wilma, Wu, and a Stripper Named Lorraine
results.overview: When a beloved desert cantina is threatened with closure, a washed-up burlesque dancer rallies an outrageous crew of misfits, church ladies, hustlers, and dreamers for one last talent show to save their town. As chaos turns to community, a feuding mother and daughter must decide whether to hold on or finally let go. ​

results.title: Tough Enough
results.overview: In a 1947 small town in Texas, societal norms are challenged when a determined teenage girl joins the high school football team.

results.title: Hotel Alcohol
results.overview: In the psychiatric hospital, the chief doctor organizes the "Olympic Games," in which protagonists Bako, Medea, and Drago form a group called "Hotel Alcohol." They lose the games, leave the hospital, and head toward the sea.
